<span style="color: red;">
**To serve**
</span>

fundamentals and
</span>
<span style="color: red;">
**to have the knowledge and skills**
</span>
<span style="color: #C0C0C0;">
required<br>
</span>
<span style="color: green;">
**to design, develop, improve, implement and control**
</span>
<span style="color: #C0C0C0;">
sophisticated production and service
</span>
<span style="color: red;">
**systems**
</span>
